detector.form: the counter's own --selftest, run against the lane at C0
detector.kill_rule: the mutant is KILLED when the counter's selftest reports a FAIL (exit != 0, pass count < 14/14); SURVIVED when the selftest still passes 14/14
detector.isolation: each mutant is a fresh copy of measure.py + a byte-identical mutants.json in its own scratch dir; the lane file is never edited (sha256 verified identical before and after)
